hero.subtitle: Your gateway to hardware simulation. Explore Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi with interactive simulators, guided tutorials, and real-world projects.
simulators.title: Choose Your Simulator
simulators.subtitle: Three powerful platforms, one seamless experience. Pick your board and start simulating instantly.
simulators.arduino.title: AyoSim Arduino
simulators.arduino.desc: Simulate Arduino circuits, write and test sketches, and visualize component interactions in real-time.
simulators.esp32.title: AyoSim ESP32
simulators.esp32.desc: Explore WiFi and Bluetooth-enabled projects with the ESP32 simulator. Test IoT applications before deploying.
simulators.rpi.title: AyoSim Raspberry Pi
simulators.rpi.desc: Simulate Raspberry Pi GPIO pins, run Python scripts, and prototype embedded Linux projects.
tutorials.title: Tutorials
tutorials.subtitle: Step-by-step guides to get you started with each simulator and board.
tutorials.t1.title: Getting Started with AyoSim Arduino
tutorials.t1.desc: Learn the basics of the Arduino simulator — setting up your first circuit and running a blink sketch.
tutorials.t2.title: Sensor Integration & Serial Monitor
tutorials.t2.desc: Connect temperature, ultrasonic, and light sensors to your Arduino and read data through the serial monitor.
tutorials.t3.title: WiFi Setup on ESP32 Simulator
tutorials.t3.desc: Configure WiFi connectivity in the ESP32 simulator and test a simple HTTP server project.
tutorials.t4.title: BLE Communication with ESP32
tutorials.t4.desc: Set up Bluetooth Low Energy services and characteristics to communicate between devices in the simulator.
tutorials.t5.title: GPIO Basics with Raspberry Pi
tutorials.t5.desc: Understand GPIO pin configuration and control LEDs and sensors in the Raspberry Pi simulator.
tutorials.t6.title: Python Automation on Raspberry Pi
tutorials.t6.desc: Write Python scripts that automate GPIO tasks — from LED sequences to sensor data logging.
articles.title: Academic Articles
articles.subtitle: Research papers, technical documentation, and in-depth references for each board.
articles.a1.title: Arduino Architecture & ATmega328P Overview
articles.a1.desc: A comprehensive look at the Arduino Uno architecture, the ATmega328P microcontroller, and its instruction set.
articles.a2.title: PWM & Timer Interrupts Deep Dive
articles.a2.desc: Understanding pulse-width modulation generation, timer registers, and interrupt-driven programming on AVR.
articles.a3.title: ESP32: Dual-Core Programming & FreeRTOS
articles.a3.desc: Explore the ESP32's dual-core Xtensa architecture, task scheduling with FreeRTOS, and power management.
articles.a4.title: ESP32 WiFi & Bluetooth Coexistence
articles.a4.desc: Technical analysis of simultaneous WiFi and Bluetooth operation on the ESP32, including antenna sharing strategies.
articles.a5.title: Raspberry Pi in Education: A Systematic Review
articles.a5.desc: Survey of Raspberry Pi applications in STEM education, covering embedded systems, IoT, and computer science teaching.
articles.a6.title: Linux Kernel & GPIO Driver Internals
articles.a6.desc: Deep dive into the Raspberry Pi's Linux kernel GPIO subsystem, device tree overlays, and driver architecture.
projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Real-world project ideas you can build and test right in the simulators.
projects.p1.title: Smart Traffic Light System
projects.p1.desc: Build a traffic light controller with pedestrian crossing detection using LEDs and sensors.
projects.p2.title: Ultrasonic Distance Meter with LCD
projects.p2.desc: Use an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor to measure distances and display the readings on a 16×2 LCD screen.
projects.p3.title: IoT Weather Station
projects.p3.desc: Create a connected weather station that reads sensor data and publishes it via MQTT over WiFi.
projects.p4.title: Real-Time Chat over WebSocket
projects.p4.desc: Build a WebSocket server on the ESP32 that enables real-time messaging between connected clients.
projects.p5.title: Home Automation Dashboard
projects.p5.desc: Prototype a home automation system with a web-based dashboard controlling GPIO-connected devices.
projects.p6.title: Motion Detection with Camera Module
projects.p6.desc: Use the Pi Camera module with OpenCV to detect motion and trigger alerts or capture snapshots.
footer.desc: AyoSim is the AYOT simulation ecosystem for hardware education. Simulate Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi — learn electronics without the hardware.
